```{python}
import scala.collection.mutable.ListBuffer

def double(ints: List[Int]): List[Int] =
  val buffer = new ListBuffer[Int]()
  for i <- ints do
    buffer += i * 2
  buffer.toList

val oldNumbers = List(1, 2, 3)
val newNumbers = double(oldNumbers)
```

```{python}
%%mhs
sum [12,2,32]
:help
:defs
:delete Expr Interactive.Add Interactive.Val Interactive.interp
data Expr = Add Expr Expr | Val Int
interp :: Expr -> Int
interp (Add a b) = (interp a) + (interp b)
interp (Val i) = i

interp (Val 42)
```
